summary: Iter-17 SEO testing. Backend: 11/13 PASS. /api/sitemap.xml is fully correct (xml namespaces, image:image, static + listing entries, lastmod/priority/changefreq). /api/seo/listing/{id} HTML+JSON-LD Product schema is correct with offers/seller/areaServed/priceCurrency. 404 handled. Regression endpoints all OK. CRITICAL: /api/robots.txt is broken — DB override (set by GET /api/admin/seo at line 2179) returns 'User-agent: *\nAllow: /\nSitemap: …' which has NO Disallow rules and NO AI-bot allowlist (GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended/anthropic-ai). Frontend: index.html base SEO is correct. Listing detail page has TWO copies of every meta/link tag — react-helmet-async appends listing-specific tags but does not remove the static home-page tags from index.html, so crawlers/AI agents see BOTH the generic home values AND the listing values for description/keywords/og:type/og:url/og:image/canonical/twitter:image. Only <title> is replaced cleanly (because the document allows just one title element).

critical.issue: Returns the stale value persisted in db.settings._key=seo.value.robots_txt (the simple stub 'User-agent: *\nAllow: /\nSitemap: https://alhraj.online/sitemap.xml') instead of the rich default in _build_robots_txt(). Result: NO Disallow: /admin, NO Disallow: /api/, NO AI-bot allowlist (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, Applebot-Extended). This contradicts the iter-17 requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate meta/link tags injected. Listing detail page now has TWO <meta name='description'>, TWO <meta name='keywords'>, TWO <meta property='og:type'> (one 'website', one 'product'), TWO <meta property='og:image'>, TWO <meta property='og:url'>, TWO <link rel='canonical'>, TWO <meta name='twitter:image'>. Static tags from index.html are NOT removed because react-helmet-async only manages tags it created (which carry data-rh='true'). Crawlers/AI agents typically read the FIRST occurrence → they will index the generic home description/keywords/og-image instead of listing-specific values. Title is fine (only one allowed). Verified: title='مياه نوفا نقية 330 مل جديدة بسعر 2 ر.س | مكة المكرمة - الحراج بلس' (correct), but description still=home description, og:image still=alhraj.online/og-image.png, og:url still=alhraj.online/, canonical still=alhraj.online/.

Two <title> tags in <head>. Line 9 sets the SEO title, then line 76 overrides it with '<title>Emergent | Fullstack App</title>'. Browsers/crawlers without JS will see the second one (Emergent placeholder). Remove line 76.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the duplicate-tag bug, AI agents (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude) and Google crawlers reading server-rendered HTML for /listing/:id may pick the home-page generic description/keywords/og-image, defeating the iter-17 goal of per-listing discoverability. Server-side fallback at GET /api/seo/listing/{id} is correct, but the production rewrite (firebase.json) only routes /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt, NOT /listing/:id for bot user-agents — so JS-disabled crawlers landing on /listing/:id never reach the prerendered HTML.

action_items: FIX robots.txt: in /api/admin/seo POST or in seed init, store the FULL default robots_txt (with Disallow rules and AI bot allowlist) instead of the bare stub. OR change _build_robots_txt() to ALWAYS return the comprehensive default and ignore the DB override (or merge with it). Quick fix: run a one-time db.settings.update_one({_key:'seo'}, {$unset: {'value.robots_txt':1}}) so the function falls back to the rich default; or update the seed defaults at line 2179 to include the full robots policy.

FIX duplicate meta tags on listing detail: either (a) remove all per-page-variable meta/link tags (description, keywords, og:type, og:url, og:image, canonical, twitter:image, twitter:title, twitter:description) from frontend/public/index.html so they are ONLY managed by react-helmet-async, keeping just the og:site_name + theme-color + JSON-LD Organization in the static head, OR (b) add a tiny inline script in index.html that strips those tags on document load before React hydrates, OR (c) add a top-level <Helmet defaultTitle/...> with empty defaults that explicitly clears them so subsequent ListingSEO can replace cleanly.
FIX duplicate <title> in index.html: remove line 76 '<title>Emergent | Fullstack App</title>' — it overrides the proper SEO title for non-JS crawlers.
Consider adding a Firebase rewrite that routes bot user-agents on /listing/:id to /api/seo/listing/:id so AI/SEO crawlers get the prerendered HTML with embedded JSON-LD.

(Optional) Set FRONTEND_URL env var on the backend so the sitemap/robots use the correct production URL when deployed (currently defaults to https://alhraj.online which is fine if that's the prod domain).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _build_robots_txt() prefers DB-stored value over default — but the seed default for that DB record (line 2179) is missing the AI-bot allowlist and Disallow rules. Either keep the rich default-only path OR sync the seed value with the rich default.

frontend/public/index.html has comprehensive static SEO tags AND the React SPA injects per-page tags via react-helmet-async — without removing the originals, BOTH coexist. Best practice: keep only invariant tags in the static head (charset, viewport, theme-color, site_name, JSON-LD Organization) and let Helmet own everything page-variable.
frontend/public/index.html has duplicate <title> tags (line 9 SEO title + line 76 'Emergent | Fullstack App'). Non-JS crawlers see the second one.

SEO.js builds keywords by deduplicating with a Set built from a comma-joined list — fine, but listing.title is also pushed into the keyword list AND is repeated as the first split token, so it appears twice slightly differently. Minor.
No alt text on the noscript fallback image in /api/seo/listing/{id} HTML beyond the title — fine, but consider adding 'aria-label' or a more descriptive alt.
Sitemap caps at 50,000 listings + 90-day cutoff — sensible. Consider sitemap index file (sitemap_index.xml) when listings >50k for proper Google submission.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing active SA listing 0005665a-fb5c-4604-98a8-0615f4395a61 ('مياه نوفا نقية 330 مل جديدة') for the listing detail SEO verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three concrete bugs found in iter-17: (1) /api/robots.txt returns DB-overridden stub missing Disallow rules + AI bot rules — DB seed at server.py line 2179 is wrong. (2) Listing detail page injects DUPLICATE meta/link tags — react-helmet-async appends but does not remove static tags from index.html. Verified via document.querySelectorAll('meta[name=description]').length === 2 etc on /listing/0005665a-fb5c-4604-98a8-0615f4395a61. Only <title> is correctly replaced (browser-level constraint). (3) Duplicate <title> in index.html (lines 9 and 76). Backend tests file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_seo.py — re-run after fix with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_seo.py::TestRobots -v. JSON-LD Product schema at /api/seo/listing/{id} is correct (verified offers, seller, areaServed, priceCurrency=SAR). Sitemap is fully correct including image:image entries.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (robots.txt): _build_robots_txt() at server.py:2565 first checks db.settings._key=seo.value.robots_txt and returns it if set. The default seed value at line 2179 is the simple stub. Fix: either update the seed dict to include full Disallow + AI bot allowlist, OR change _build_robots_txt to always return the rich default. Bug 2 (duplicate metas): react-helmet-async only tracks DOM nodes it injects (marks them with data-rh='true'). Static tags rendered server-side (or in CRA's index.html) lack that marker, so Helmet leaves them. When ListingSEO mounts, Helmet appends new <meta> elements; querySelector returns the first match (the static one). Fix: remove per-page-variable static meta tags from index.html, leaving only invariants (charset/viewport/theme-color/Organization JSON-LD/sitemap link/og:site_name). Bug 3 (duplicate title): straight-up two <title> tags in index.html — keep line 9, delete line 76.
